sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य राजर्षेर्नष्टसञ्ज्ञस्य भाषितम् ।प्रत्युवाच शुभं वाक्यं सान्त्वयन्परया गिरा ।। ७.८९.१२ ॥
transliteration: tacchrutvā tasya rājarṣernaṣṭasañjñasya bhāṣitam ।pratyuvāca śubhaṁ vākyaṁ sāntvayanparayā girā ।। 7.89.12 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the bewildered words of that royal sage, Budha replied with auspicious words, consoling him with a supreme voice.
